queries.query: large language model OR LLM "network configuration" OR "network configurations" "NetOps" "configuration synthesis"
queries.rationale: Locate primary work on using LLMs to generate network configurations or translate intent→configuration (phenomenon and task formulations).
Identify papers describing hallucination-like failure modes or incorrect/invented facts in network-oriented LLM outputs (phenomenon / failure modes).
Find work on translating operator intent or policies stated in natural language into device-level configs; reveals mapping errors and evaluation methods.
Survey architectures that pair generation with validators or iterative repair loops (mitigations / methods).
Collect deterministic verification and static-analysis tools for network configs to use as validators or ground truth (mitigation & benchmark validity).
Survey Batfish-style works and empirical evaluations showing what validators can/cannot detect (construct validity of validators).

queries.query: AIOps OR "A I Ops" "network operations" machine learning troubleshooting anomaly detection dataset benchmark
queries.rationale: Locate broader AIOps literature and benchmarks for automated network management and fault diagnosis (neighbouring work & methods).

queries.query: "LLM" OR "large language model" "agentic" "network operations" OR NetOps OR "agentic agent"
queries.rationale: Search for work on agentic/agent-driven NetOps workflows that orchestrate LLMs and external tools (architectures, safety).
Find existing benchmarks that test LLMs on networking tasks; assess their scope and construct validity for operational claims (benchmark validity).

queries.query: Mininet OR GNS3 OR NS3 "network emulation" "configuration testing" "evaluation"
queries.rationale: Identify emulation/simulation platforms used to execute and validate generated configs (methods, experimental environments).

queries.query: datasets "network configuration" "BGP" "router configs" public dataset "network configs"
queries.rationale: Locate public corpora of router/switch configs, topology datasets, and labeled misconfigurations for empirical studies and reproducibility.
Find work on adversarial or stress testing of configuration generators and validators (mechanisms of failure, robustness testing).

queries.query: "construct validity" OR "external validity" benchmark networking simulation "NetOps"
queries.rationale: Search methodological literature on validity threats for benchmarks and simulators relevant to NetOps evaluations (benchmark validity & threats).
Survey studies on human oversight, handoff, and operator workflows with automated NetOps tools (mitigation via human oversight).

queries.query: program synthesis OR "code generation" "LLM" "verification" "synthesis with verifier"
queries.rationale: Leverage neighbouring fields (program synthesis, code generation with verifiers) for methods transferable to NetOps generate+verify patterns.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed papers, workshop papers, or archival preprints with verifiable bibliographic metadata.
Empirical studies, implemented systems, or reproducible tool descriptions relevant to LLMs/automated methods applied to networking/NetOps.
Works about validators, formal verification, or emulation/simulation platforms used to assess network configurations.
Benchmarks, datasets, or measurement studies for network configuration, troubleshooting, or automated NetOps.
Papers from 2016–2026 (emphasis on 2019–2026) and foundational earlier work when directly cited as basis.
Publicly available datasets, tools, or code artifacts when referenced.
Studies discussing failure modes, safety, human-in-the-loop, or agentic orchestration in operational contexts.
exclusion_criteria: Non-technical blog posts or marketing material without primary technical content or verifiable references (unless they point to a primary source).
Works unrelated to network operations or configuration (pure NLP tasks with no networking application).
Proprietary internal-only reports inaccessible for verification.
Papers that only present anecdotal or unsupported claims without methods, data, or evaluation.
Pre-lock internal development artifacts (per programme prohibition) and any non-public preprints.
date_rationale: Cover literature from roughly 2016–2026 to capture foundational formal-verification and NetOps work (pre-LLM era) and the rapid LLM/agentic literature surge since 2019–2024; emphasize recent (2020–2026) empirical studies, benchmarks, and tools while allowing earlier foundational methods (e.g., NetKAT, Batfish, Mininet) that underpin validators and simulators. Also plan backward/forward citation chaining and inclusion of the most recent 2025–2026 preprints and conference papers up to the current date.
